assertions.statement: The healthy sample scenario is APPROVED with a trust score of at least 90% and every layer passing.
assertions.howToVerify: Open /verify. The 'healthy' scenario is selected by default. Check the decision badge reads APPROVED, the radial score is >= 90%, and all five layer rows show a score of at least 85.

assertions.statement: Tampered data is not approved: 'inflated' and 'replay' are REJECTED, 'spikes' and 'polluted' are FLAGGED.
assertions.howToVerify: On /verify click each scenario button in turn and read the decision badge after each click.

assertions.statement: Editing the readings JSON re-runs verification and shows validation errors for malformed input.
assertions.howToVerify: On /verify replace the textarea content with '[]' and confirm an error is shown instead of a report; restore a scenario and confirm the report returns.

assertions.statement: An APPROVED report shows the exact HCS message and its reportHash, and publishing requires an operator API key.
assertions.howToVerify: With 'healthy' selected, find the '3. HCS anchor' card: it shows JSON with schema 'hydro-dmrv/report@1', a 0x-prefixed reportHash, and an 'Anchor & attest' button that stays disabled until a key is typed.

assertions.statement: The home page explains the flow and how agents connect over MCP, and /llms.txt describes the API.
assertions.howToVerify: Open /: a 'How it works' section lists Meter, Verify, Anchor, Issue, Settle; a 'Built for AI agents' section shows a /api/mcp URL. Open /llms.txt and confirm it lists the MCP tools.

assertions.statement: Without a deployment the market and audit pages explain how to deploy instead of crashing; with one they show the Chainlink HBAR/USD price and listings.
assertions.howToVerify: Open /market and /audit. Either an info alert says HydroREC is not deployed and names the deploy command, or the HBAR / USD (Chainlink) card and an 'Open listings' heading are visible.
